_note: The lifesteal path (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8g, path 1; phase 8 part 5, 8e-2b). First numbers.
name: Bloodglut
title: the one who drinks past full
fantasy: She drinks past full and keeps swelling.
placement: In the thick of the enemies, where her lifesteal never runs dry.

vowed.taste: Engorge: lifesteal past full HP raises her max HP for the rest of the fight, up to 5% more.

passives.name: Engorge
passives.text: Lifesteal past full HP raises her max HP for the rest of the fight, up to a little more.

passives.name: Engorge
passives.text: Engorge stops at a little more max HP than she started with.

transformed.text: Engorge has no cap, and Rend deals extra damage for her max HP. Gorge replaces Drain: a strike that grows with her max HP, with half of it drunk. Drain becomes a habit, every 8th Rend. The transformation also gives +15% HP and +10% ATK.

basic_attack.name: Rend
basic_attack.text: A clawing strike at the enemy beside her that heals her by part of the damage. Where most of her mana comes from.

signature.name: Gorge
signature.text: She gorges on an enemy within 1 hex: a strike that grows with her max HP, healing her by half the damage.

passives.name: Engorge
passives.text: Lifesteal past full HP raises her max HP for the rest of the fight, with no cap.

passives.name: Drain
passives.text: A habit: every 8th Rend, she tears into her target and drinks half the damage.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 5 (rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-2c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Leviathan
apexes.title: the tide that rises in her
apexes.fantasy: She drinks until she is the size of what she has drunk, and drinks the more for it.

vowed.taste: Rend's bonus damage is 4% of her max HP, not 3%.

basic_attack.name: Rend
basic_attack.text: A clawing strike at the enemy beside her that heals her by part of the damage. Where most of her mana comes from.

apex.text: Engorge raises her max HP by one and a half times the lifesteal past full, and Rend's bonus is 4% of her max HP. Every 10% max HP she gains gives her +3% lifesteal for the rest of the fight. No stat lift: she grows her own.

basic_attack.name: Rend
basic_attack.text: A clawing strike at the enemy beside her that heals her by part of the damage. Where most of her mana comes from.

passives.name: Engorge
passives.text: Lifesteal past full HP raises her max HP by half as much again for the rest of the fight, with no cap.

passives.name: Leviathan
passives.text: Every tenth of her max HP that Engorge adds makes her lifesteal stronger.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 5 (rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-2c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Sanguine Nova
apexes.title: the heart that bursts outward
apexes.fantasy: All she has swallowed comes back out of her at once, and the room drowns in it.

vowed.taste: Gorge also hits enemies within 1 hex of its target for half its damage.

signature.name: Gorge
signature.text: She gorges on an enemy within 1 hex, and the enemies within 1 hex of it take half: strikes that grow with her max HP, healing her by half the damage.

apex.text: Sanguine Nova replaces Gorge: the max HP Engorge has added bursts out as damage to every enemy within 2 hexes, and she loses that bonus. Each Nova makes Engorge grow 20% faster for the rest of the fight. Gorge becomes a habit, every 5th Rend. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

signature.name: Sanguine Nova
signature.text: The max HP Engorge has added bursts out of her as damage to every enemy within 2 hexes, and she loses that bonus.

passives.name: Gorge
passives.text: A habit: every 5th Rend, she gorges on her target and the enemies within 1 hex of it, healing her by half the damage.

passives.name: Nova Hunger
passives.text: Each Sanguine Nova makes Engorge grow faster for the rest of the fight.

deed.text: Damage Gorge deals to enemies beside its target

_note: The Poison path (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8g, path 2; phase 8 part 5, 8e-2b). Poison is 1 damage a stack a second and never fades. First numbers.
name: Plaguebearer
title: the one whose wounds fester
fantasy: Every wound she opens festers, and she feeds on the sick.
placement: Beside the toughest enemies, so her Poison has time to work.

vowed.taste: Blight: Rend applies Poison equal to 7% of her ATK.

passives.name: Blight
passives.text: Rend poisons the enemy it strikes. Poison never fades.

transformed.text: Rend applies twice the Poison, and her lifesteal is doubled against Poisoned enemies (her hits only; Poison itself never lifesteals). Plague Burst replaces Drain: a cloud around her that poisons every enemy in it each second. Drain becomes a habit, every 8th Rend.

signature.name: Plague Burst
signature.text: A cloud of plague within 2 hexes of her for 4s: every enemy inside is poisoned each second.

passives.name: Blight
passives.text: Rend poisons the enemy it strikes. Poison never fades.

passives.name: Plague Feast
passives.text: Her lifesteal is doubled against Poisoned enemies.

passives.name: Drain
passives.text: A habit: every 8th Rend, she tears into her target and drinks half the damage.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 5 (rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-2c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Gravecaller
apexes.title: the plague that walks again
apexes.fantasy: What her rot kills does not stay down; it gets up and fights for her a while.

vowed.taste: A Poisoned enemy that falls leaves a corpse cloud for 2s: Poison equal to 10% of her ATK each second to enemies within 1 hex.

passives.name: Corpse Cloud
passives.text: A Poisoned enemy that falls leaves a cloud within 1 hex of where it fell for 2s, poisoning every enemy inside each second.

apex.text: Poisoned enemies that fall rise as her thralls, up to 3 at once: for 8s, at 30% of their HP, with their own kit, fighting for you (never summons, elites, bosses, or the void's fallen). Each thrall raised makes later ones rise with 10% more HP and last 2s longer, for the rest of the fight. Corpse clouds stay. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

passives.name: Corpse Cloud
passives.text: A Poisoned enemy that falls leaves a cloud within 1 hex of where it fell for 2s, poisoning every enemy inside each second.

passives.name: Gravecaller
passives.text: A Poisoned enemy that falls rises as her thrall for a while, fighting for her, up to 3 at once; each one raised makes later ones stronger and longer-lived.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 5 (rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-2c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Pestilence
apexes.title: the cloud that does not lift
apexes.fantasy: Every death in her cloud thickens it.

signature.name: Plague Burst
signature.text: A cloud of plague within 2 hexes of her for 5s: every enemy inside is poisoned each second.

apex.text: Plague Burst covers 3 hexes and lasts 5s, and enemies inside deal 15% less damage. Each enemy that falls while Poisoned makes all her Poison 15% stronger for the rest of the fight. The apex also gives +15% HP.

signature.name: Plague Burst
signature.text: A cloud of plague within 3 hexes of her for 5s: every enemy inside is poisoned each second and deals less damage.

passives.name: Pestilence
passives.text: Each enemy that falls while Poisoned makes all her Poison stronger for the rest of the fight.

deed.text: Poison Plague Burst applies (one an enemy a second in it)

_note: The blood caster (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8g, path 3; phase 8 part 5, 8e-2b). Transformed, she casts from her HP whenever she's above half. First numbers.
name: Hemomancer
title: the one who bleeds for power
fantasy: Every drop above the line is a spell.
placement: Behind the front line, within 3 hexes of the enemies, with a healer near.

vowed.taste: Blood Price: Drain costs 30 mana and 5% of her max HP, instead of 60 mana.

signature.name: Drain
signature.text: She tears into an enemy within 1 hex and drinks: a heavy strike that heals her by half the damage. It costs some of her HP too.

transformed.text: She becomes a caster within 3 hexes and starts every fight at half her HP. Blood Bolt (her MGK, 25% lifesteal) replaces Rend. Exsanguinate replaces Drain: whenever she's above half her HP she spends a tenth of it on a blast at her target and the enemies beside it, stronger for the HP spent. Drain becomes a habit, every 8th Blood Bolt, on her MGK.
transformed.cost: She starts every fight at half her HP.

basic_attack.name: Blood Bolt
basic_attack.text: A bolt of blood at the nearest enemy within 3 hexes that heals her by part of the damage.

signature.name: Exsanguinate
signature.text: Whenever she's above half her HP, she spends some of it on a blast at an enemy within 3 hexes and every enemy within 1 hex of it, stronger for the HP spent. No lifesteal.

passives.name: Drain
passives.text: A habit: every 8th Blood Bolt, she tears at her target from afar with her MGK and drinks half the damage.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 5 (rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-2c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Blood Tide
apexes.title: the vein opened wide
apexes.fantasy: She bleeds herself near to empty, and every drop comes back a flood.

vowed.taste: She starts fights at 55% HP, not 50%.

apex.text: She starts at 55% HP and casts Exsanguinate down to 30% HP, not 50%, and it adds 3 times the HP spent, not 2. Each cast gives Blood Bolt +2% lifesteal for the rest of the fight. The apex also gives +15% HP.

signature.name: Exsanguinate
signature.text: Whenever she's above 30% of her HP, she spends some of it on a blast at an enemy within 3 hexes and every enemy within 1 hex of it, stronger for the HP spent. No lifesteal.

passives.name: Blood Tide
passives.text: Each Exsanguinate makes Blood Bolt drink more for the rest of the fight.

passives.name: Tidal Thirst
passives.text: Blood Bolt drinks more for each Exsanguinate she has cast.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 5 (rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-2c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Blood Rite
apexes.title: the offering shared
apexes.fantasy: What she spends of herself, her allies drink as strength.

vowed.taste: Each Exsanguinate gives allies within 2 hexes of her +5% ATK for 3s.

signature.name: Exsanguinate
signature.text: Whenever she's above half her HP, she spends some of it on a blast at an enemy within 3 hexes and every enemy within 1 hex of it, stronger for the HP spent, and lifts the allies within 2 hexes of her. No lifesteal.

apex.text: Each Exsanguinate gives every ally +20% ATK and MGK for 4s. Every 100 HP she spends gives every ally +2% ATK and MGK for the rest of the fight. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

signature.name: Exsanguinate
signature.text: Whenever she's above half her HP, she spends some of it on a blast at an enemy within 3 hexes and every enemy within 1 hex of it, stronger for the HP spent, and every ally fights harder for a while. No lifesteal.

passives.name: Sacred Blood
passives.text: Every 100 HP she spends makes every ally stronger for the rest of the fight.

deed.text: Hits her allies land while Blood Offering lifts them
